items.l1: Now it is medicine that suits each individual person's body.
items.notes: At floor; blind back-translation differs from gold only in 合った vs 合う, so the reference is faithful and the low score is synonym noise.

items.l1: The minute workings that we adults so often overlook, he keeps etching, innocently and solemnly.
items.notes: Loose: 'recording' read the 刻み続ける metaphor as writing things down (cues 記録) and 'tiny' undershot 微小; changed to 'etching' and 'minute', kept 'innocently' as the standard gloss of 無心に.

items.l1: In apartments with limited space in the city, modern interior design greatly influences the impression of a space.
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: gap is loanword vs native choice (モダン/現代的, アパートメント/アパート, 都会/都市部) and the です-ending, which English cannot mark; meaning is identical.

items.l1: I like the picture of a bear.
items.notes: Exact match; blind back-translation differs only in 好き vs すき orthography, a scoring artifact.

items.l1: Subsequently, superimpose jam, such as raspberry, onto the paired counterpart, or onto the same slice.
items.notes: Meaning was right but register was flattened: gold is mock-technical (次いで, 片割れ, 同一の切片, 重ね合わせる) and the reference read as a plain recipe step; raised to 'Subsequently', 'superimpose', 'paired counterpart'.

items.l1: Paying no mind to the coldness of the harsh winter, he is purely and wholly absorbed in getting ready to play outside.
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: 余念がない and 厳冬 are idioms with many valid Japanese targets; 'he' is the subject English requires and the context supplies, nothing added.

items.l1: The food given at this time of day is a mixture of fresh grain and vegetables harvested locally.
items.notes: At floor; differences are synonyms only (餌/食べ物, 収穫された/採れた, 混ぜた/混ぜ合わせた), and the 'locally' scope matches the gold.

items.l1: At that time I saw it in a shop, and the kitten in the picture caught my attention at once.
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: 是…的 location focus is carried by English end-weight, and 立刻/一下子 and 吸引了我/吸引了我的注意 are interchangeable.

items.l1: The reason I like this T-shirt is, to a large extent, because of this picture.
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: 之所以…很大一部分原因 vs 很大程度上 are equivalent framings of the same claim.

items.l1: It must not tell lies.
items.notes: Gold drops the subject (the company, from context), English needs 'It'; 说假话 vs 说谎 are synonyms, so the reference is faithful.

items.l1: This method has greatly increased the recycling rate of plastic bottles.
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: 让…大幅提高 vs 大大提高了 differ only in construction.

items.l1: This T-shirt has also given me more inspiration for putting outfits together.
items.notes: Gold is corrupted: subject reads 这件T恤的T恤 ('this T-shirt's T-shirt'), a duplication glitch that also hits idx 33; reference matches the evident intent and should stand once the transcript is fixed.

items.l1: I can pair it with jeans, and I can also pair it with casual trousers.
items.notes: Faithful; English needs the object 'it' that the gold leaves implicit, and the low score is structure variance (把它和…搭配 vs 搭配…).

items.l1: It goes with everything; whatever the occasion, it can be worn.
items.notes: Faithful; blind back-translation matched the gold except 不管 vs 无论.

items.l1: I once considered buying a new T-shirt with a more complicated pattern on it, or a more fashionable design.
items.notes: Loose: nouns were crossed, 'design' for 图案 and 'style' for 设计 (which cues 款式); now 'pattern' for 图案 and 'design' for 设计.

items.l1: This T-shirt has also taught me to value things more.
items.notes: Gold is corrupted with the same 这件T恤的T恤 duplication as idx 26; reference renders the intended 也让我更懂得珍惜 correctly and should stand once the transcript is fixed.

items.l1: This meritocratic, performance-oriented culture gives rise to flat, self-organizing community structures.
items.notes: Gold mixes scripts: it holds the English word 'meritocratic' plus a parenthetical gloss （绩效导向）, and the next sentence does the same with guild and clan; the reference mirrors the content faithfully, but the transcript needs fixing.

items.l1: Soap and water can clean our hands.
items.notes: Literal match; low score is 能清洁 vs 可以把…洗干净 synonym variance.

items.l1: It is a plush teddy bear named "Xiongxiong".
items.notes: Faithful; gold splits the name into a second clause (…，名叫“熊熊”), and pinyin Xiongxiong is the standard English form of the name.

items.l1: Exporting means selling goods abroad.
items.notes: Literal match; 意味着 vs 就是 synonym variance.

items.l1: Importing is buying goods from other countries.
items.notes: Literal match; 别的/其他 and 买进/购买 synonym variance.

items.l1: Many countries now do not allow plastic bags to be used.
items.notes: Borderline (0.69 vs 0.70) from colloquial 不让用 vs 不允许使用; the passive avoids inventing a subject, so it stays as is.

items.l1: Each country has different rules.
items.notes: Literal match to 每个国家有不同规定; low score is the restructured back-translation (…都不一样), not the reference.

items.l1: This way, flowers can bear fruit.
items.notes: Literal match; 可以结出果实 vs 就可以结出果实 only.

items.l1: In ancient times, people built the Great Wall for defence.
items.notes: Faithful; the purpose focus of 是为了防御 sits in English end position, and the low score comes from 为了防御修建 vs 修建…是为了防御 word order.
